must_have_properties: 800 Gb/s MAC PRESERVING the IEEE 802.3 Clause-4 frame format (preamble 7x0x55 + SFD 0xD5 + DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad + FCS).
PRESERVED min (64 B) and max (1518 B / 1522 B VLAN) frame size.
RS-FEC(544,514) KP4 forward error correction in the PCS.
PAM4 modulation at 106.25 GBd per 100 Gb/s lane.
MAC / RS / PCS / PMA / PMD layering per IEEE 802.3.
PCS 64b/66b + 256b/257b transcoding + multi-lane distribution with alignment markers.
One of the 800GBASE-DR8 / SR8 / VR8 / 2xFR4 PMDs.
must_not_have_properties: Any CSMA/CD or half-duplex operation at 800 Gb/s.
A Clause-22 BMCR/BMSR register file (800G is Clause-45-only).
Operation without RS-FEC (the raw PAM4 lane BER is far above target).
Modifying the Clause-4 MAC frame format or the min/max frame size.
NRZ line modulation on the 100 Gb/s lanes (800GBASE uses PAM4).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: >15 symbol errors in an RS-FEC(544,514) codeword; frame discarded; uncorrected counter increments.
SerDes equaliser fails to converge within the training timer.
Sustained pre-FEC error ratio exceeds the FEC budget.

fields.min_link_constraint: An 800GBASE link shall reach PCS block + alignment-marker lock and FEC alignment, with post-FEC BER <= 1e-13, over the compliance channel for its PMD variant (DR8/SR8/VR8/2xFR4).
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: On reset the SerDes re-train, the PCS re-acquires block + alignment lock, and FEC re-aligns before the link is reported up via the Clause-45 PCS status MMD.
fields.frame_boundary_compliance: TX_EN must assert synchronous with the first preamble nibble and remain asserted continuously through all nibbles of the frame; must de-assert before the next TX_CLK rising edge after the final FCS nibble. RX_DV must encompass the frame starting no later than the SFD and de-assert before the next RX_CLK after the final FCS nibble.
fields.address_filter_compliance: Receive MAC must accept (a) its own unicast MAC, (b) the broadcast address FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF, (c) any multicast address it has been programmed to listen for, and (d) all frames in promiscuous mode (when enabled). Hash-based filtering of the multicast superset is implementation-defined.
fields.frame_format_preservation_compliance: The 800 Gb/s MAC frame shall be byte-for-byte identical to base IEEE 802.3 (preamble/SFD/DA/SA/Type/Length/Payload/Pad/FCS) and the min/max frame size shall be unchanged — a mandatory P802.3df objective.
